ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black/dark pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric masses occupy the central-medial portions of both lobes. Dense black pigmentation borders the trailing edge and surrounds the median notch. Distinctive dark, parallel vertical bands are located on the inner right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees; the vertex region is partially obscured by water turbulence and spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right trailing edge shows high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; left trailing edge exhibits deep, irregular macro-notches (concave disruptions); right distal tip shows extreme irregular pixel-amplitude clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve fitted to both fluke lobes tapering towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel nodes at the far right distal tip; multiple small dark circular spots (mottling) distributed across white ventral surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent series of 6-8 parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the inner right lobe; finer, unaligned diagonal linear marks visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake mark scarring on right lobe; irregular loss of tissue/notching on the left lobe trailing edge; significant barnacle colonization on the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'rib-like' parallel dark pigmentation pattern on the medial section of the right lobe.
